rationale: I read the full held EO 11532 (35 FR 8629-8630) and the full held EO 11981 (42 FR 17095-17096). EO 11532 establishes the Interdepartmental Committee for the Voluntary Payroll Savings Plan and supersedes EO 10626; no sunset or savings clause. EO 11981 sec. 5: 'This Order supersedes Executive Order No. 11532 of June 2, 1970.' The supersession names the whole order with no section or time limit, and EO 11981 re-establishes a successor committee covering the same functions, so nothing of EO 11532 remains as an independent command. No held source suggests revival. Independent view NO; I agree. Effective date of the supersession (signing vs. publication) stays a lifecycle gap.
